title: Where a customer-deployed Cloud Connector VM can be deployed

prose.text: Apart from the AWS AMI table, the captured help has no region list for the Cloud Connector VM; what it does say is cloud-specific. The Zero Trust Gateway tables are not a VM allowlist: [[cloud-connector.regions.zero-trust-gateways]].

Per-region availability of the VM in AWS China and in AWS regions outside the ZS42.1.0 row, GCP, Azure Government and other sovereign clouds, and of each VM size, is not captured {{gap:standard-cc-regions}}.

checks.do: For Azure China, whether the deployment used Terraform rather than the Marketplace application.
For any region outside commercial Azure, whether the cloud's marketplace lists the image, or Zscaler confirms support.

aws-ami-regions.statement: The AWS AMI table lists the ZS42.1.0 image (March 10, 2026) in af-south-1, ap-east-1, ap-east-2, ap-northeast-1 to ap-northeast-3, ap-south-1, ap-south-2, ap-southeast-1 to ap-southeast-7, ca-central-1, ca-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-central-2, eu-north-1, eu-south-1, eu-south-2, eu-west-1 to eu-west-3, il-central-1, mx-central-1, sa-east-1, us-east-1, us-east-2, us-gov-east-1, us-gov-west-1, us-west-1 and us-west-2.

azure-marketplace-regions.statement: The Zscaler Cloud Connector Application in the Azure Marketplace is available in all regions except China; deploying from the China region requires Terraform.

quotes: The Zscaler Cloud Connector Application in the Azure Marketplace is available in all regions except China. If you are deploying Cloud Connector from the China region, you must use Terraform.

azure-china-gateway.statement: For Cloud Connector in China, Zscaler recommends a custom gateway with Zscaler China data centers and traffic forwarding policies that reference the China location and that custom gateway.

quotes: If you are deploying Cloud Connector in China, Zscaler recommends creating a custom gateway with Zscaler China data centers and traffic forwarding policies referencing your China location and custom gateway.

gcp-terraform.statement: The GCP deployment guide deploys Cloud Connector as a VM using Terraform.

quotes: how to deploy Zscaler Cloud Connector as a virtual machine (VM) on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
This procedure describes the steps for deploying Zscaler Cloud Connector using Terraform.

vm-size.statement: In the cloud provisioning template, AWS offers Small, Medium or Large, with Small the default when autoscaling is enabled; for Azure and GCP the page says only that Small is set by default.

quotes: Amazon Web Services: Select from Small, Medium, or Large. Small is set by default when autoscaling is enabled.
Azure: Small is set by default.
GCP: Small is set by default.

vm-size.conditions: Absence claim: `grep -c -F Medium` and `grep -c -F Large` on vendor/zscaler-help/cbc-configuring-cloud-provisioning-template.json each return 1, both in the Amazon Web Services item; the VM Size item's Azure and GCP sub-items are exactly "Azure: Small is set by default." and "GCP: Small is set by default."

standard-cc-regions.title: Region availability of the customer-deployed Cloud Connector VM
standard-cc-regions.detail: Unverified legacy statements and open questions: the AWS ZS42.1.0 AMI row lists `us-gov-east-1` and `us-gov-west-1` (aws-ami-regions), but no cn-* region appears in either the ZS42.1.0 or ZS6.1.26.1 row of that table, which is an absence and not a statement that AWS China is unsupported; `me-central-1` and `me-south-1` are listed only in the older ZS6.1.26.1 row; AWS China (`cn-north-1`, `cn-northwest-1`) is otherwise not addressed, and a GovCloud blog post reportedly names Cloud Connector without regional detail; Azure Government and other sovereign Azure clouds are not addressed; AWS China "likely" needs the same China gateway handling as Azure; the GCP VM's region list is not enumerated, and a 2026 release entry reportedly names a Google Cloud Marketplace image (the release-summary capture holds only its introduction); whether VM sizes other than Small exist for Azure and GCP, or vary by region, is not stated; the Azure Function App Flex Consumption plan is unavailable in some Azure regions, affecting VMSS deployments. The region-set comparison is in cloud-connector.regions:region-set-parity.
standard-cc-regions.blocks: telling an operator whether a Cloud Connector VM can be deployed in a given region or sovereign cloud
